This '''[[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' was a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] during the events surround the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], when the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] made their thrust for domination of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A member of a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], this [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] defense force when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fleet arrived prepared for war. He served alongside [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] such as [[Memit Nadill]], [[Tuknatan]], and [[Sonam-Ha'ar]], and the Coruscant soldiers in pushing back the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] threat. Once Coruscant was protected, this Jedi was part of the fleet the followed the Sith back to their region of space to ensure their forces were decimated, so that the threat they posed was unquestionably defeated.

As a Jedi Guardian, this Jedi was an expert on tactics, weapons, [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and vehicles used in combat during his [[Time/Legends|time]]. His weapon of choice was not a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but rather a [[lightstaff]] imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], whose ends both glowed with a resonant [[Color/Legends|blue]] energy signature.
